issues.description: Silent fallback when git resolution fails reports full coverage instead of erroring
issues.detail: findChangedFiles returning null is coerced to undefined, indistinguishable from 'feature disabled.' A user who asked for changed-only coverage silently gets full coverage on any git failure (bad ref, missing git, not a repo). Worst kind of bug: looks like it worked. Fail loud or warn with the resolved ref.

issues.description: Path-shape mismatch between changedFiles and the slash+cleanUrl filename is unproved
issues.detail: isIncluded compares slash(cleanUrl(absolute_filename)) against entries from VitestGit.findChangedFiles, which typically returns git-root-relative paths. The equality test silently never matches on non-trivial layouts (Windows, root != git root). Normalize both sides through the same resolve+slash pipeline and add a test that proves it.

issues.description: changedFiles is mutable provider state with stale-across-reruns and implicit-time hazards
issues.detail: this.changedFiles is set in onTestRunStart but never reset when options.changed is falsy on a subsequent run, and globCache is only cleared when changedFiles is set. In watch mode this leaves a stale filter and poisoned cache. Make the changed set an explicit snapshot scoped to a run, or reset and clear unconditionally at run start.

issues.description: CLI transform handles boolean inputs that argv parsing cannot deliver
issues.detail: The transform branches on value === true and value === false, but CLI argument values arrive as strings. Either dead code or it papers over a typing lie upstream. Delete the boolean branches or document where non-string values originate. Don't ship both.

issues.description: cleanUrl normalization in isIncluded is bundled silently with the feature
issues.detail: The filename normalization changed from slash(_filename) to slash(cleanUrl(_filename)). Query params and hashes are now stripped before matching for all users, regardless of the new option. Split this behavioral change into its own commit with a regression test, or document why the feature required it. Bisect-hostile as submitted.

issues.description: No end-to-end test exercises a real git ref through the coverage.changed path
issues.detail: Every new coverage test passes changed: 'HEAD' against working-tree fixtures. None resolves a non-HEAD ref via VitestGit through coverage.changed end-to-end, so path-normalization and git-failure modes are uncovered. Add a test that resolves a branch or tag via coverage.changed and asserts only changed files are included.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The feature is useful and the happy-path tests read well, but the patch glues three changes together (new option, new lifecycle hook wired at three call sites, silent cleanUrl semantic change) and ships a load-bearing path-equality check that is never proved. The most dangerous defect is silent semantic collapse: a null from VitestGit.findChangedFiles is indistinguishable from 'feature disabled,' so a git failure silently reports full coverage. Mutable provider state for changedFiles also leaves stale filters and a poisoned globCache across watch-mode reruns. Split the cleanUrl change into its own commit, normalize paths on both sides with a test, scope changedFiles to a run, and fail loud on git resolution failure.
